== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon (PC 2026 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. The whole of the disc card and the whole of the D-E1 card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
